children.value: Press the round button on the bridge
pal asks the bridge every second; the panel comes back on its own once the key is in.

1-rooms.caption: Rooms and zones with their colour, how many lights are on and the brightness; Enter toggles, cmd+Enter opens the room

2-light.caption: A light under the keys: the tile in its colour, brightness, the temperature strip, the colour plane, presets, scenes and effects

3-room.caption: A room under the keys, its scenes row focused: the arrows choose, Enter plays

4-scenes.caption: Scenes by room as five-swatch strips, the active and dynamic ones tagged

5-sensors.caption: Sensors and switches by device: motion, temperature, light level, the last button press, batteries

6-setup.caption: Set up Hue waiting for the button, with the countdown
